$comment: Heroic-mode defeat outcomes (spec §9; campaign bible DESIGN.md §13). The first outcome whose `when` matches is used. Every outcome heals the hero to 1 HP, clears death saves, advances the clock and increments world.times_defeated. `relocate` moves the party to a lore location (or `temple`: the nearest temple-tagged location in the region). Money losses are fractions of the hero's coins.

outcomes.text: The Maw heaves and vomits you up onto its rim, gasping. Something precious was torn from you in the dark.
The dragon tosses you from its lair like refuse. You wake at the foot of the peak, burned and bruised.
You wake in a Choir holding cell. Hours later, a loose stone and a desperate squeeze get you out — but your captors have moved on.
Lantern Wardens find you in the reeds and carry you to Lantern Hold. After a day of quarantine they let you go — for a fee.
Briarkin hands bind your wounds with moss and thorn. You wake at Thornwife Hollow, owing them a favor.
Priests find you among the dead and carry you to their temple. You wake to candlelight and a request for a tithe.
You wake on the deck of a Red Gull sloop, soaked and alive. The captain names a salvage fee, and takes it.
You wake in a cell. Three days later a bored jailer lets you go with a warning.
You wake at the roadside, head pounding. Your purse is lighter, and something else is missing too.
You wake where you fell, hours later. Whatever attacked you has lost interest.
Somehow you are dragged to safety. You wake hours later, aching but alive.
